segment: At ten years old,
I could not figure out what it was
that this Elvis Presley guy had
that the rest of us boys did not have.
He seemed
to be no different from the rest of us.

It must have been something pretty superlative

because he had every young girl
at the orphanage

At about nine o'clock on Saturday morning,
I figured a good solution was
to ask Eugene Correthers,

what it was
that made this Elvis guy so special.
He told me
that it was not anything about Elvis's personality,
but his wavy hair, and the way he moved his body.
About a half an hour later,
the boys in the orphanage,
called down to the main dining room by the matron,
were told
that they were all going to downtown Jacksonville, Florida
to get a new pair of Buster Brown shoes and a haircut.
That is when I got this big idea,

If the Elvis haircut was the big secret,
then Elvis's haircut I was going
to get.
I was going
to have my day in the sun,

that was all I talked about.

my idea was something

grinned back at me and said
that he would try his best.
I was so happy
when he started
to cut my hair,

to cut,
the matron,

the man

The kindly barber
stopped by the matron
did not answer,

that he wished
he could cut it as I had asked.
Within a few minutes,
it wasn't an Elvis haircut, but a short buzz cut

When he finished
shaving off all my hair

I handed him the nickel back and told him

'I'm so sorry, baby,' he said,
as I climbed out of his barber chair.
'I am not a baby,' I said,

I then sat down on the floor and brushed away the hair
that had accumulated on my shiny new Buster Brown shoes.

my haircut was something
